title: Fast-growing Hawk Fire explodes to 10,000 acres, spurs evacuations outside Reno
description: About 1,000 homes were threatened, authorities said.

title: ‘It’s Been Terrible’: Thousands in Indiana Remain Without Power
description: Gov. Mike Braun called on the local utility to “match the urgency” of Gary area residents who have had to endure an outage approaching its second week.

title: Liberty’s Leonie Fiebich has big night, shows rare on-court emotion in return from lengthy injury
description: Leonie Fiebich is usually stoic on the court for the Liberty. But playing her first game in seven weeks Saturday, she let the emotion pour out.

title: Judge denies Karmelo Anthony's appeal for a new trial in killing of Austin Metcalf
description: The decision comes after both prosecutors and Anthony's new defense team revealed more details in a tense two-day hearing.

title: Maniac fires wildly on Brooklyn Street, shooting dog that miraculously survived
description: Police are hunting for a ruthless gunman who opened fire on a Brooklyn street Wednesday afternoon, nearly killing a developmentally delayed woman and leaving her family's beloved dog bleeding from a bullet wound.

title: Iran declares it has won the war as U.S. turns to economic warfare
description: Iran's president said Friday the world had "approved" the country's victory, as Vice President JD Vance declares economic pressure "the most effective tool that we have."

title: The Papers:  'Power to block nimby protests' and Meghan 'deal could be off'
description: New mayoral powers and continued reporting on the Duchess of Sussex's television role lead Sunday's papers.

title: AOC announces completion of egg retrieval journey, vows to share more public updates on process
description: “Squad” Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, 36, completed her egg-freezing journey, vowing to share more updates despite past “negativity.”

title: Mets’ Luis Robert Jr. belts two homers in win over his ex-team
description: Luis Robert Jr.’s visit to his old stomping ground undoubtedly will be remembered as a highlight of his season.

title: Chinese humanoid robot beats Usain Bolt's sprint world record
description: Two human records were smashed by robots competing in the Olympics-like World Humanoid Robot Games in China.

title: Ex-Colombian president: Restoring Israeli ties applauds Gaza genocide
description: Ex-Colombian President, Gustavo Petro, says restoring ties with Israel amounts to applauding the Gaza genocide.
